step.name: Public home
step.instruction: Open the dev app in a fresh browser session.
step.expectation: Sign in is visible; team usage is not visible.

step.name: Sign in
step.expectation: My Tracker opens with the DEV AUTH banner and token creation form.

step.name: Overview
step.expectation: Seeded projected cost, tokens, active users, average, leaderboard, and ingestion health are visible without rendering errors.

step.name: Visualizations
step.instruction: Click Visualizations and scroll through the page.
step.expectation: Daily cost, token types, UTC weekday rhythm, model/harness mix, user streams, sessions, and coding blocks render without broken tables or charts.

step.name: Currency
step.instruction: On Overview, record USD amounts, switch to EUR, then switch back to USD.
step.expectation: Cost labels and amounts change to EUR; token counts stay unchanged; switching back restores the original USD amounts.

step.name: Information links
step.instruction: Open Data scope, return with Back to overview, then open What’s new in the footer.
step.expectation: Data scope explains local-only usage and estimated costs; return navigation works; What’s new shows release history.

step.name: Small screen and themes
step.instruction: Inspect Overview and My Tracker at a 390-pixel viewport width in light and dark modes, then restore the desktop viewport.
step.expectation: Text remains legible; navigation and controls remain reachable; no whole-page horizontal overflow occurs.

step.name: Create token
step.instruction: On My Tracker, create a token labeled golem-tester; mask its secret before taking the screenshot.
step.expectation: Tracker token created appears with a shown-once warning, Copy token, and Download toktrak.mjs controls.

step.name: Revoke token
step.instruction: Return to My Tracker and revoke golem-tester.
step.expectation: Token is listed as revoked without a Revoke button; its plaintext secret is not displayed.

step.name: Sign out
step.expectation: Public home appears with Sign in and no team usage.
